questions.question: Who first put forward the idea of a Constituent Assembly for India?
questions.explanation: M.N. Roy first put forward the idea of a Constituent Assembly in 1934.

option_analysis.A: Correct — he proposed the idea in 1934.
option_analysis.B: Incorrect — Nehru later played a major role.
option_analysis.C: Incorrect — Gandhi supported constitutional development but was not the first proposer.
option_analysis.D: Incorrect — Ambedkar later chaired the Drafting Committee.

questions.upsc_trap: Do not confuse the origin of the idea with later leaders who shaped the Assembly.
questions.key_fact: The Assembly was eventually constituted in 1946 under the Cabinet Mission Plan.
questions.linkage: Connect this with the Cabinet Mission Plan and indirect election.

questions.question: The Constituent Assembly was constituted mainly under which plan?
questions.explanation: The Constituent Assembly was constituted in 1946 under the Cabinet Mission Plan.

option_analysis.B: Correct — the 1946 plan provided the framework.
option_analysis.C: Incorrect — it concerned transfer of power and partition.
option_analysis.D: Incorrect — it preceded the Cabinet Mission.

questions.upsc_trap: UPSC can test chronology by mixing Cripps, Wavell, Cabinet Mission and Mountbatten.
questions.key_fact: Members were elected indirectly by provincial legislatures.
questions.linkage: Connect the plan with composition, indirect election and partition.
